review_comments.body: shouldnt this be `user_var.is_some() || home_var.is_none()`. Not that it did that before, but now i'm wondering if we shouldn't generally be ensuring that HOME is set.
I'd prefer using the `temp_env` crate over recursively calling the test binary.

comments.body:
Thanks, switched the tests to `temp_env::with_vars` and dropped the child-process re-invocation (6108abf). The three cases (USER unset, USER matching, stale USER) still pass.

Good catch on the condition: it is now `user_var.is_some() || home_var.is_none()`, so HOME is also set to the user's home dir when it is missing. Added a fourth test for USER and HOME both unset.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
